title: Route PointsSummaryWidget's 'pts'/'Current Balance' strings through AppLocalizations
why: This is a bilingual EN/HE app where AX-2 requires every user-facing string through AppLocalizations/ARB (1421-key EN/HE parity enforced by make arb-parity). These two literals never got that treatment. The widget is currently dead (see the companion dead-code finding) so today's blast radius is zero, but the moment anyone reconnects it, Hebrew-locale users see raw untranslated English with no ARB-parity check able to catch it, since arb-parity only validates keys that exist — it cannot detect a literal that was never turned into one.
recommendation: Route both strings through AppLocalizations (reuse the existing pointsAbbrev key used by DashboardLevelPointsCard, and add a currentBalance key) before this widget is ever reconnected, or delete it per the companion finding.
acceptance_criteria: no bare string literal remains in points_summary_widget.dart's build() — l10n replaces both Text('...') literals
